q: Is CircoLoco Records owned by Rockstar Games?

q: Is "Don't Stop" by Prospa on CircoLoco Records?
a: Yes. It came out April 11, 2025 as CLR015, per Discogs and RockstarINTEL. It builds on a hook from Somethin' For The People's 1997 song "My Love Is the Shhh!".

q: Who is on "Free Your Mind" by Prospa?
a: The title track features Cloonee, and Beatport-derived charts also credit Sybil. It is the title track of Prospa's debut album, released on CircoLoco Records on June 5, 2026, which also features Josh Baker, RAHH, Kosmo Kint and Murda Beatz.

q: How do I get the CircoLoco Media Sticks in GTA Online?
a: Since Los Santos Tuners (July 20, 2021), four Monday Dreamin' EP sticks - Black, Blue, Violet and Green - are hidden around the map and play on the Media Player. Collecting all four unlocks Seth Troxler's CLR Launch Party mix and a CircoLoco tee.

q: Is the Music Locker a CircoLoco Records club?
a: No source links them. The Music Locker opened with The Cayo Perico Heist in December 2020, five months before the label was announced, with Moodymann, Keinemusik and Palms Trax as residents.

q: Will GTA 6 have a CircoLoco radio station?
a: Only a leak says so. We Rave You reported in August 2026 an unconfirmed clip showing "CircoLoco Records Radio", but Rockstar's October 2026 station reveal, as GamesRadar reported it, named six stations and no CircoLoco station.
